risks.proof: A photo of the backrest with the top cushion removed.

risks.risk: The armrests may be loose or have hidden damage.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the armrest joints.

proof_requests: Photo of the backrest with the top cushion removed to check for tears or stains.
Photo of the foam inside the cushions to check for wear.

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a 2-seater couch from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case (worn foam and stains) until further proof is provided.
